AgentDefinition.description: One file in /agents. Adding an agent = adding a YAML file.

plannable.description: false = never assigned tasks by the planner (e.g. AUDITOR)

AgentDefinition.title: AgentDefinition

AgentState.description: Live runtime state of one agent (what the Agent Board renders).
AgentState.title: AgentState

AgentStatus.description: Operational status shown on the Agent Board.
AgentStatus.title: AgentStatus

check.description: which check raised it: dashboards | l10 | rocks | …

fingerprint.description: stable key so the same finding updates instead of duplicating

AlertEvidence.description: A verbatim line from a source, so every alert can be checked.

source.description: file name, API resource or email subject

AlertEvidence.title: AlertEvidence

ApprovalReason.description: Why a human must intervene (spec section 11).
ApprovalReason.title: ApprovalReason

AskMessage.description: One turn of the "Ask ATLAS" conversation (docs/MEMORY.md).

remember.description: facts from the human's message worth saving

suggest_mission.description: an objective to launch when it needs new work

AskMessage.title: AskMessage

AtlasEvent.description:
Every event carries a human-readable `summary` for the Activity Feed
and a typed `payload` for the widgets that react to it.
AtlasEvent.title: AtlasEvent

download_url.description: API path to download a file ATLAS stores

Audit.description: AUDITOR's check of one agent report against the evidence the system recorded for its task.

checks.description: deterministic checks the system ran first

revision_task_id.description: the revision task opened for a FAIL

final.description: audit of a revision: no further revision is opened

Audit.title: Audit

finding.description: the finding or passage questioned, quoted

Brief.description: The weekly L10 brief ARGOS prepares (a deliverable plus a structured summary).
Brief.title: Brief

BrowserConfig.description:
Opt-in browser for one agent: its own dedicated, persistent browser profile (never the user's Chrome).

The human logs into the site once in that profile (`atlas-browser login <agent>`); the agent then opens,
reads, clicks, fills filters, extracts tables and downloads files, only on `allowed_domains`.
Strings may use ${ENV_VAR} so personal sites stay out of the public repo.

allowed_domains.description: hosts the agent may open (subdomains included); comma lists allowed

max_turns.description: turn budget of tasks that use the browser

BrowserConfig.title: BrowserConfig

ClaimKind.description: ORACLE's rule: never present an assumption as a fact.
ClaimKind.title: ClaimKind

Digest.description: A CC briefing produced by an inbox scan (docs/INBOX.md §4).

skipped.description: CC emails excluded by rules or as automated

documents.description: SCRIBE's institutional PDF of the digest

Digest.title: Digest

DigestThread.description: One conversation where the user is only in CC, summarized.

project.description: from the user's local project keywords

asks_me.description: what someone asked the user, if anything

DigestThread.title: DigestThread

DivisionDefinition.description: A team of specialist agents shown as one expandable unit (e.g. the EOS division).

lead.description: agent id that triages work for the division

DivisionDefinition.title: DivisionDefinition

EmailDraft.description: A reply or follow-up ALFRED drafted. ATLAS never sends email.
EmailDraft.title: EmailDraft

EmailRef.description: Minimal pointer to the source email. Full bodies are never stored.

excerpt.description: the few lines that support the follow-up (≤ 400 chars)

EmailRef.title: EmailRef

Evidence.description:
A record of something an agent actually did, written by the system (never by the agent).

Reports and the activity feed are built from these, so claimed actions are provable.

ref.description: path, URL, agent id or approval id

Evidence.title: Evidence

mission_id.description: the inbox scan that found it

KnowledgeNote.description: A fact the human told ATLAS about their world (docs/MEMORY.md): dated, per node, given to every run.
KnowledgeNote.title: KnowledgeNote

Lesson.description:
A durable preference the human taught an agent (docs/LESSONS.md). Proposed lessons wait for approval;
active ones are added to that agent's instructions in every future run.

agent_id.description: agent id, or '*' for every agent

text.description: the rule, as the agent will read it

node.description: only in this node; None = every node

replaces.description: lesson ids retired when this one is approved

Lesson.title: Lesson

MemoryRef.description: An earlier mission / brief / digest an answer drew on.
MemoryRef.title: MemoryRef

interrupted.description: was running when the server stopped

publish.description: SCRIBE formats the report as institutional documents

MissionPhase.description: The nine-step lifecycle from the project spec.
MissionPhase.title: MissionPhase

documents.description: institutional documents SCRIBE rendered from this report (PDF, deck)

topics.description: projects, areas and people this mission is about

audit_summary.description: what AUDITOR checked and what it found (system-written)

untraced.description: figures in this report that appear in no agent report or evidence (system check)

NodeDefinition.description:
An isolated operating context (e.g. corporate, personal).

Isolation rule: a mission lives in exactly one node. Node-bound agents only work on missions of
their node; shared agents (nodes: ['*']) serve every node but never carry context between them.
NodeDefinition.title: NodeDefinition

RockStatus.description: A Rock tracked by ARGOS from the user's private rocks file.

required_pace.description: units per week needed from today

RockStatus.title: RockStatus

round.description: 1 = initial plan; 2+ = follow-up rounds from the mission thread

retries.description: automatic re-runs after a transient failure

revision_of.description: task id whose report AUDITOR sent back for revision

Usage.description: Token usage and estimated cost (USD) for a mission or agent.
Usage.title: Usage
